title: CS213: Data Structures and Algorithm – Department Academic Mentorship Program
description: # CS213: Data Structures and Algorithm. **Motivation-** Introduction to data structures, abstract data types, analysis of algorithms. **Feedback on Labs, Tutorials, Assignments and Exams-** The lectures were held in LA due to a strength of 182. There were no in-class quizzes just a simple lecture. Sadly there were no labs this time due to unavailability of TAs. Programming assignments given proved helpful for practice. This course requires a continuous input of efforts. This is not a course you can mug up a night before the exam. The concepts require time and practice to build and hence this course should not be taken lightly. There were a total of 3 Quizzes with a weightage of 23% each, 2 Programming Assignments with a weightage of 2% each and an End-Sem of 50%. **Grading Statistics-** The grading was not great with just 5 AAs, 11 ABs, 20 BBs and 33 FRs out of 182. + Department Academic Mentorship Program* Already have a WordPress.com account?

title: CS213 – Data Structures and Algorithms | Department Academic Mentorship Programme
description: # Department Academic Mentorship Programme. # CS213 – Data Structures and Algorithms. **Grading Stats:** Good, grading was lenient as the course content was on a heavier side. **Course Content:** Basic data structures and algorithms, their implementation and use cases. **What was the evaluation pattern?** 2 quizzes (15% each), 1 mid semester exam (30%) and end semester exam (40%). Papers were subjective and mainly involved writing pseudocodes for problems. **What was the mode of the lectures?** Offline. **What was the attendance policy of the course?** None. **Were there any assignments/project in the course?** Theory course didn’t have any assignments or projects. Project on algorithmic trading was a part of the DSA lab course (CS 293). **How were the exams?** 2 quizzes, 1 midsem exam and 1 endsem exam. ### Share this:. * Share on X (Opens in new window) X. * Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook. + Department Academic Mentorship Programme* Already have a WordPress.com account?
